metadata.title: Nutanix Stock Surges as Cloud and Agentic AI Partnerships With AMD Pay Off<!-- --> - Barron's

content.text:
Nutanix Surges as Cloud and Agentic AI Partnerships With AMD Pay Off
Nutanix stock was rallying Thursday after the cloud-computing company, best known for its agreements with chip giants Advanced Micro Devices and Nvidia, posted better-than-expected earnings.
